provenance.why_not_bls_or_bea: BLS returns HTTP 403 on every host from this network; BEA returns HTTP 200 with a zero-length body without a UserID.  Neither publishes vintages.  See docs/research/2026-08-18-mc2-inflation-source-probe/.
provenance.values_are_real: Every number was fetched from the live source at authoring time and frozen with the vintage that made it knowable.

expect.note: Headline and core are far apart in level while moving the same way. Level divergence and direction divergence are separate claims and the engine must not report one as the other.
The core move is broad on the median measure, so breadth does not contradict core -- but the breadth measures contradict each other, which lowers confidence without changing the state.

derived_from_inputs.identity_note: T10YIE is defined by the publisher as DGS10 - DFII10, so this residual is an identity check on the fetch, never evidence about term premium.

expect.note: Both legs move; the engine states the split instead of picking a driver.

derived_from_inputs.spread_is_between_forward_paths_only: The actual midpoint is where rates ARE, not where they are going.  Including it in the spread measures curve slope, not path disagreement.
derived_from_inputs.why_the_mean_is_meaningless: SEP dots fall on an eighth-point grid and market pricing is a probability-weighted contract rate.  Their average is neither: no participant projected it and no contract prices it.
